description: Will buyer agents choose my x402 API? The Machine Buyer Panel is an A/B conversion test: buyer-agent models choose between your offer and its real Bazaar rivals for up to three tasks, across buyer personas and list positions. Returns your win rate with confidence intervals, why you lost, and up to three truthful edits tested on the same trials. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
